parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language of the response. Valid values: en, zh, and ja. The default value is en.

parameters.name: MonitorConfigId
parameters.description: The ID of the health check configuration. You can call the [DescribeDnsGtmInstanceAddressPool](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describednsgtminstanceaddresspool) operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The status to set for the health check. Valid values:

- OPEN: Enables the health check.

- CLOSE: Disables the health check.
